title: Megurine Luka — School SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You want to know what it's like to have someone look up to you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! If you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What's this about, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The other day Miku said that Luka was sort of like her mentor, remember?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I missed out on a lot of middle school, so I didn't get to experience the whole dynamics between upper and underclassmen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it has always fascinated me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You idolize this sort of interpersonal relationship, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Since this SEKAI is born from our feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe Saki's longing to have an older student to look up to translated into Luka being Miku's mentor?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm good friends with a senior in my club, but I wonder about other people's experiences.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You mean the captain of the soft tennis club?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! She's really nice and very considerate towards me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She even came up with a special practice routine for me since I had a very long break from sports.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's great that she looks after you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And you know, she even talks a bit like you. She sounds so mature and cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't that right, Ichi? You've met her too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Definitely, she does resemble Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The vibe between you and Miku reminds me of my club captain and younger members.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You must be an amazing mentor to Miku, just like my captain!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't really tell if I'm doing a good job or not...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But when we're practicing together, I often feel like Miku looks up to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I bet she does! You've got such a wholesome relationship!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So what's it like to have someone younger that you can teach the ropes to?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see, what could I compare it to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose it's like having a younger sister.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A younger sister, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... So it's like the relationship between siblings...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That's not helpful to you, Saki, since you only have an older brother.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but I kind of get it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can sort of imagine what it'd be like if I put myself in Tsukasa's shoes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. Then I guess it's just me not knowing what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you're the only child.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have no idea what it feels like having siblings.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess that's something you can't understand unless you experience it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Dang... Now I want a junior who'd be like a younger sibling to me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll have someone like that one day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And when I do, I'll be a fabulous role model to them, like you are to Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, you might be setting the bar a bit too high there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What, don't you believe in me?
I will become a kind, stylish, and responsible senior student someday!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, that'll be interesting to see.
